comments.content: Descendants marked BLOCK_FAILED_CHILD here have their nStatus mutated but are never inserted into m_blockman.m_dirty_blockindex, so the change is not persisted to disk and setBlockIndexCandidates is not cleaned up for them. The same dirty/candidate cleanup that is done for to_mark_failed should be applied to these descendants.

Removing the m_failed_blocks walk in AcceptBlockHeader means a header that descends from a previously invalidated block can be accepted and stored. The old check rejected such headers immediately with BLOCK_INVALID_PREV. Without it you will accept headers that are guaranteed to be invalid, increasing work and diverging from the previous invariant that m_best_header is always valid.
